name: Skepticism
overview: Scripture reveals skepticism as a heart attitude of unbelief and rejection of God’s authority and goodness. Figures like Pharaoh question the LORD’s identity and refuse to obey Him, exemplifying hardened disbelief. The Psalms call such deniers fools, highlighting their corruption and moral failure in declaring there is no God. Job’s skeptics question the value of serving or praying to the Almighty, while Zephaniah condemns those who doubt God’s justice and providence. Together, these verses expose skepticism as a dangerous spiritual condition that rejects the truth of God’s existence and His righteous governance.
